name: Industrial Finishes
old_description: Industrial Finishes is proud to be Featuring 3M products Since 1958
about:
Industrial Finishes, headquartered in Reno, Nevada, has been featuring 3M products since its founding in 1958. The Reno location originated from the acquisition of Barrett Paints and Re-Neva Paint, with the facility refreshed in 2012 to include a dedicated training center capable of hosting up to 50 people.

The company distributes paint finishes, industrial coatings, paint supplies, surface preparation materials, hand power tools, equipment, abrasives, safety products, and clips and fasteners. It also provides business support and educational training, including painter certification, color matching, paint line conversion, mixing system training, and shop process evaluation. Industrial Finishes operates four regional training centers and offers on-site and video-enabled instruction. The Reno team collectively holds over 100 years of experience, and the location serves a 150-mile radius as the primary paint supplier for Lake Tahoe and Reno.

Industrial Finishes serves the automotive, RV and specialty vehicle, military, industrial/panel, equipment sales, infrared curing, construction, and aerospace/defense sectors. Concrete customers include Drone America, one of the largest drone providers for the U.S. government, and local construction firms. The company's philosophy centers on "rolls, floats, or flies" applications, developing finishing systems for virtually any substrate.

The company emphasizes a "national presence, local support" model, stating that the sale is just the beginning of their duty and they strive to re-win business daily through timely delivery of quality products. Their guiding principles include openness, accountability, risk-taking within limits, a commitment to doing it right, learning from mistakes, integrity, collaboration, and courage in the face of difficulty.
